visual_goal: Show three products on one data spine with three shared gates: Charter controls entry, disclosure control controls what leaves the cube, and the file exchange enforces retention.
prompt: A left-to-right architecture illustration. Far left: a tall column of stacked database cylinders labeled 'Data spine'. Three parallel lanes run right from it, each starting with one box: top 'Enrichment jobs', middle 'Insight cube', bottom 'Scoring'. Above all three lanes, a long horizontal gate bar labeled 'Charter' with one downward arrow into each of the three boxes, the middle arrow labeled 'purpose check'. Right of 'Insight cube', a filter box labeled 'Disclosure control'. Right of 'Scoring', a box with two interlocking rings labeled 'Match-in'. Far right, a delivery box with a small calendar icon labeled 'File exchange'. Arrows: one arrow from 'Data spine' into each of 'Enrichment jobs', 'Insight cube' and 'Scoring'; one arrow from 'Insight cube' to 'Disclosure control'; one arrow from 'Disclosure control' to 'File exchange'; one arrow from 'Enrichment jobs' to 'File exchange' labeled '30-day deletion'; one arrow from 'Scoring' to 'Match-in'.
alt: A data spine feeds enrichment jobs, an insight cube and scoring; Charter's purpose check gates all three; the cube passes through disclosure control, enrichment output goes to a file exchange with 30-day deletion, and scoring feeds match-in.

visual_goal: Show the enrichment job as a state machine where partial completion is a first-class state and deletion is the end state for every job, including rejected ones.
prompt: A simple left-to-right state map of eight rounded tiles. Top row from left: blue 'Received', blue 'Validated', teal 'Running', green 'Completed', green 'Delivered', grey 'Deleted'. Below 'Running' and 'Completed', an orange tile 'Partial'. Below 'Received', a red tile 'Rejected'. Arrows: one from 'Received' to 'Validated'; one from 'Received' down to 'Rejected' labeled 'checks fail'; one from 'Validated' to 'Running'; a small circular loop arrow on 'Running' labeled 'retry chunk'; one from 'Running' to 'Completed'; one from 'Running' down to 'Partial' labeled 'live columns deferred'; one from 'Partial' up to 'Completed'; one from 'Completed' to 'Delivered'; one from 'Delivered' to 'Deleted' labeled '30 days'; one long arrow along the bottom from 'Rejected' to 'Deleted'.
alt: An enrichment job goes from Received to Validated, Running, Completed, Delivered and Deleted after 30 days; Running may retry a chunk or become Partial before Completed; Received jobs that fail checks are Rejected and then Deleted.

visual_goal: Show disclosure control as one serving layer between the cube and every delivery channel, so no channel can bypass it.
prompt: A top-to-bottom illustration. Top: two input boxes side by side, a stack of event cards labeled 'Vehicle events' and a set of ruler-like axes labeled 'Dimensions'. Both arrows point down into a cube-shaped block labeled 'Cube release'. Below it, a wide horizontal filter band spanning the full width labeled 'Serving layer', drawn like a sieve with some cells greyed out. To the left of the band, a small document box labeled 'Suppression policy' with one arrow into the band. Below the band, three output boxes side by side: a chart screen labeled 'Dashboards', a printed page labeled 'Reports', and a file sheet labeled 'Data files'. Arrows: one arrow from 'Vehicle events' to 'Cube release'; one arrow from 'Dimensions' to 'Cube release'; one arrow from 'Cube release' to 'Serving layer'; one arrow from 'Serving layer' to each of the three outputs. No arrow goes around the band.
alt: Vehicle events and dimensions build a cube release, which passes through one serving layer governed by a suppression policy before reaching dashboards, reports and data files.

visual_goal: Show match-in: the dealer submits its own customers' plates, Charter allows own customers only, objections are removed first, and only bands for matched plates come back; submitted plates are discarded.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with five vertical lanes, each headed by a small icon and a label: a dealer desk computer labeled 'Dealer', two interlocking rings labeled 'Match-in', a stamp labeled 'Charter', a crossed-out envelope labeled 'Objection list', and a database cylinder labeled 'Score store'. Horizontal message arrows from top to bottom: one arrow from 'Dealer' to 'Match-in' labeled 'customer plates'; one arrow from 'Match-in' to 'Charter' labeled 'check grant'; one return arrow from 'Charter' to 'Match-in' labeled 'own customers only'; one arrow from 'Match-in' to 'Objection list' labeled 'remove objections'; one arrow from 'Match-in' to 'Score store' labeled 'fetch scores'; one return arrow from 'Score store' to 'Match-in' labeled 'bands'; one green arrow from 'Match-in' back to 'Dealer' labeled 'matched plates only'. At the bottom of the 'Match-in' lane, a small paper shredder icon.
alt: Swimlanes: the dealer sends customer plates to match-in; Charter allows own customers only; objections are removed; scores are fetched as bands from the score store; only bands for matched plates return to the dealer, and the submitted plates are shredded.
